Dans ce cas, il produit la description écrite des mesures prises. Les mesures correctrices peuvent être mentionnées dans le formulaire d’offre. Les mesures correctrices, tant pour tous les critères d'exclusion facultatifs que pour tous les critères d'exclusion obligatoires, doivent être soumises sur l'initiative du candidat/soumissionnaire. Pour les éléments qui ne relèvent pas de la déclaration implicite, les documents et certificats qui démontrent que l’opérateur économique ne se trouve pas dans une situation d’exclusion, sont présentés au plus tard à la date ultime d’introduction des demandes de participation ou des offres. Pour ce qui concerne les critères de sélection et le cas échéant les règles et critères objectifs pour la limitation du nombre de candidats, les documents et certificats sont présentés au plus tard à la date ultime d’introduction des demandes de participation ou des offres. Durant la procédure de passation, le pouvoir adjudicateur peut à tout moment demander aux soumissionnaires d’introduire la totalité ou une partie des documents justificatifs requis afin de vérifier l’exactitude de la déc

uelle du cessionnaire couvrira la totalité des prestations exécutées, en ce compris celles ayant déjà été exécutées par le cédant. Un adjudicataire qui, durant l’exécution du marché, ferait l’objet d’une procédure de réorganisation judiciaire (ou de toute situation similaire), s’engage expressément à ne pas suspendre ou interrompre l’exécution du marché (voir Art XX.56, § 1er et 2 du Code de droit économique). Succession On entend ici une succession universelle ou partielle de l’adjudicataire initial, à la suite d’opérations de restructuration de société, notamment de rachat, de fusion, d’acquisition ou d’insolvabilité, assurée par un autre opérateur économique qui remplit les critères de sélection établis initialement, à condition que cela n’entraîne pas d’autres modifications substantielles du marché. La règle « de minimis » Une modification peut être apportée au marché lorsque la valeur de la modification est inférieure au seuil fixé pour la publicité européenne et à dix pour cent de la valeur du marché initial. Lorsque plusieurs modifications successives sont effectuées, le montant est déterminé sur la base de la valeur cumulée nette des modifications successives. Verklaring aangaande de uitsluitingsgronden en/of selectiecriteria Impliciete verklaring op erewoord Door eenvoudig deel te nemen aan deze procedure tot gunning van de overheidsopdracht en door zijn aanvraag tot deelneming of offerte in te dienen, verklaart de kandidaat of inschrijver op erewoord zich niet in één van de voorziene uitsluitingsgevallen te bevinden als bedoeld in de Art 67, 68 en 69 van de wet. Wat de selectiecriteria betreft moeten de documenten en certificaten ten laatste op het uiterste tijdstip voor de indiening van de aanvragen tot deelneming of de offertes worden voorgelegd. Opmerking: de aanbestedende overheid gaat enkel voor de als opdrachtnemer in aanmerking komende inschrijver na of deze zich effectief niet in één van de voormelde uitsluitingsgevallen bevindt. De aanbestedende overheid zal in deze context een uittreksel strafregister opvragen van de natuurlijke persoon die de offerte/indieningsrapport heeft ondertekend, alsook van de rechtspersoon. Tevens behoudt ze zich het recht voor andere overtuigende stukken op te vragen. Wanneer meerdere ondernemingen deel uitmaakten van een combina

geval bevindt en corrigerende maatregelen doet gelden overeenkomstig Art 70 van de wet, slaat de impliciete verklaring op erewoord niet op elementen die verband houden met de betreffende uitsluitingsgrond. In dat geval legt hij de schriftelijke beschrijving van de genomen maatregelen voor. In het offertebiljet kan melding gemaakt worden van corrigerende maatregelen. Corrigerende maatregelen dienen, zowel voor alle facultatieve alsook voor alle verplichte uitsluitingscriteria, op initiatief van de kandidaat/inschrijver te worden voorgelegd. Verklaring aangaande de uitsluitingsgronden en/of selectiecriteria Impliciete verklaring op erewoord Door eenvoudig deel te nemen aan deze procedure tot gunning van de overheidsopdracht en door zijn aanvraag tot deelneming of offerte in te dienen, verklaart de kandidaat of inschrijver op erewoord zich niet in één van de voorziene uitsluitingsgevallen te bevinden als bedoeld in de Art 67, 68 en 69 van de wet. Wat de selectiecriteria betreft moeten de documenten en certificaten ten laatste op het uiterste tijdstip voor de indiening van de aanvragen tot deelneming of de offertes worden voorgelegd. Opmerking: de aanbestedende overheid gaat enkel voor de als opdrachtnemer in aanmerking komende inschrijver na of deze zich effectief niet in één van de voormelde uitsluitingsgevallen bevindt. De aanbestedende overheid zal in deze context een uittreksel strafregister opvragen van de natuurlijke persoon die de offerte/indieningsrapport heeft ondertekend, alsook van de rechtspersoon. Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Em paralelo, e para efeitos de execução do contrato, o prestador pode demonstrar cumulativamente, se detém certificação nas normas:ISO14001:2015 ISO 9001:2015 e ISSO/IEC 27001:2022, respetivamente. 3. O prestador deve assegurar que estas certificações se mantenham, para ambas as normas durante todo o período contratual. 4. O prestador pode incluir na sua resposta os documentos de certificação emitidos por parte de organismos de certificação acreditados, caso os detenham. 5. Quaisquer subcontratados envolvidos na prestação de serviços devem igualmente trabalhar sob os sistemas de gestão de qualidade e segurança do prestador detentor destas certificações Subsecção IV Equipa de Serviço Cláusula 11.ª Unidade Local de Saúde Santa Maria, E.P.E. Para efeitos da execução e ao abrigo do contrato, o ULSSM e o prestador de serviços procedem às seguintes atividades de tratamento de dados pessoais: a) O prestador de serviços trata dados pessoais de representantes, trabalhadores e/ou utentes do ULSSM; b) O ULSSM trata dados pessoais de representantes, trabalhadores, agentes, subcontratados e consultores do prestador de serviços. 2. O tratamento dos dados pessoais encontra-se limitado, nos termos do artigo 6.º, n.º 1, alíneas b) e c) do RGPD, a finalidades exclusivamente relacionadas com a execução da prestação de serviços ou com o cumprimento de obrigações jurídicas a que o ULSSM e o prestador de serviços estejam adstritos. 3. O ULSSM e o prestador de serviços assumem a obrigação de estrita confidencialidade relativamente a todos os dados pessoais de que venham a ter conhecimento no âmbito do contrato, extensiva à informação a que os seus trabalhadores, agentes, subcontratados e consultores tenham acesso, garantindo que os mesmos assumiram um compromisso de confidencialidade. 4. O ULSSM e o prestador de serviços apenas podem transmitir dados pessoais a que tenham acess

dos recursos que prestarão o serviço, donde resulte claramente a evidência dos requisitos estipulados no anexo I do Caderno de Encargos do presente procedimento; e) Para efeitos da alínea anterior: i. apenas serão admitidos curriculum vitæ, também abreviado para CV, sendo este documento de tipo histórico, de onde seja possível relacionar o período de tempo ao facto, relatando a trajetória educacional e as experiências profissionais da pessoa que irá desempenhas as tarefas objeto do presente contrato, não sendo admitidas notas curriculares efetuadas pelo adjudicatário. ii. references_experience.text: ncil can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application management, assessment workflows, award administration, post-award monitoring, reporting, and integration with the Arts Council’s existing Finance Management System. The organisation's strategic preference is for a solution that requires minimal custom development and can be configured using standard platform functionality. For further information on the Arts Council, please visit our website www.artscouncil.ie. Background and Objective The Arts Council is undertaking the replacement of its existing Grant Management System (GMS), a critical business application that underpins the administration, assessment, award, and ongoing management of public funding programmes. The current platform has been in operation beyond its supported lifecycle for over a decade and now presents significant operational, cybersecurity, governance, and business continuity risks. The replacement programme has therefore been established primarily as a risk mitigation and service continuity initiative to ensure the Arts Council can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application

e, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the existing environment. The new system must support bilingual service delivery (Irish and English), modern digital user experiences, robust security controls, workflow automation, management reporting, and interoperability with current and future finance platforms. The solution should also align with public sector best practice, including cloud-first principles, accessibility requirements, data protection obligations, cybersecurity standards, and emerging NIS2 requirements. This procurement will be conducted through a Competitive Procedure with Negotiation to ensure transparency, value for money, and market competition. The successful solution will play a central role in enabling The Arts Council to maintain resilient grant administration services while providing a platform for future enhancement and digital innovation across the organisation. Hinweise zur Angebotsabgabe Anzahl Bewerber In Einklang mit § 51 Abs. 2 VgV wird die Zahl der zur Angebotsabgabe aufzufordernden Bewerber auf mindestens drei und höchstens fünf festgelegt. Die festgelegte Mindestzahl von drei Bewerbern entspricht den gesetzlichen Anforderungen für das Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb. Die vorgesehene Höchstzahl von fünf Bewerbern gewährleistet einen ausreichenden Wettbewerb und ermöglicht zugleich eine sachgerechte und wirtschaftliche Durchführung des weiteren Vergabeverfahrens. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung und betriebliche Optimierung einer innovativen KI-basierten Individualsoftware. Die Prüfung und Bewertung der Angebote erfordert eine vertiefte fachliche Analyse der vorgeschlagenen Lösungsansätze sowie gegebenenfalls die Durchführung von Verhandlungsgesprächen. Mit zunehmender Zahl der einzubeziehenden Bieter steigt der hierfür erforderliche personelle und zeitliche Aufwand erheblich. Die Begrenzung auf höchstens fünf Bewerber dient daher dem Ziel, einen wirksamen Wettbewerb sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig ein effizientes und verhältnismäßiges Vergabeverfahren zu ermöglichen. Nach Einschätzung der Auftraggeberin ist bei einer Teilnehmerzahl von bis zu fünf Bewerbern ein ausreichender Wettbewerb gewährleistet. Sofern mehr als fünf geeignete Bewerber einen Teilnahmeantrag einreichen, erfolgt die Auswahl der zur Angebotsabgabe aufzufordernden Bewerber anhand der in den Vergabeunterlagen veröffentlichten Auswahlkriterien und der hierzu festgelegten Auswahlmatrix . sen in dossiers, risicoanalyses, beleidsvoorbereiding en advisering. Nach der Digitalisierung und Sicherung werden die Images der Kranken - und Pflegekasse nach Ziffer 4.5. übermittelt. 4.1. Dokumentenvorbereitung Der Scanprozess beginnt grundsätzlich mit dem Eingang des papiergebundenen Dokumentes im Unternehmen zu Abrechnungszwecken bzw. beim Abrechnungsdienstleister. Um eine vollständige Erfassung der Belege des Posteingangs/ des zu verarbeitenden Beleg- volumens eines Leistungserbringer-IK im Scanprozess zu gewährleisten, werden die Papier- dokumente sorgfältig vorbereitet und sortiert. Dies umfasst auch folgende Maßnahmen: • grundsätzliche Überprüfung, ob die Belege für die Erfassung/Abrechnung vorgesehen sind • Lösen von Klammern, Entfernung von Knicken und nicht relevanten Klebezetteln • Notiz-/Klebezettel (Post-IT) auf einem gesonderten Blatt fixieren, wenn diese relevante Inhalte überdecken 4.2. Versicherte, mit einem Haushaltsvolumen von mehr als 11 Mrd. im Jahre 2024. Für weitere Effizienzsteigerungen in den Proze ssen soll die Rechnungsbearbeitung digitalisiert werden. Konkret betroffen sind dabei die Abrechnungspro- zesse gem. § 302 SGB V und § 105 SGB XI. In diesen Leistungsbereichen erhält die Auftraggeberin aktuell heterogene Abrechnungen. Diese erfolgen nach den Maßgaben der Technischen Anlagen für Sonstige Leistungserbrin- ger.1 Die Abrechnungen beinhalten teilweise mit übermittelte Images (nach dem ImageLink Verfahren). Überwiegend werden neben den Abrechnungsdaten jedoch keine Images, son- dern lediglich die rechnungsrelevanten Unterlagen in Papierform a

nd werden neben den Abrechnungsdaten jedoch keine Images, son- dern lediglich die rechnungsrelevanten Unterlagen in Papierform an die Auftraggeberin über- mittelt. Bei einem geringen Anteil erfolgt die Leistungsabrechn ung vollumfänglich in Papier- form. Bisher erhaltene Abrechnungen der Leistungserbringer und/oder deren Dienstleistern, die in Papierform eingehen, sollen durch den Auftragnehmer digitalisiert und so der Auftraggeberin zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Dadurch erleichtert sich für die Auftraggeberin die Rechnungs- bearbeitung und es wird Potenzial für Prozessoptimierungen und -automatisierungen geschaf- fen. Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. 1.1 Losbildung Eine Losbildung unterbleibt, da ein ganzheitlicher Scandienst mit der Gesamtverantwortung des künftigen Auftragnehmers ausgeschrieben wird. Ausgeschrieben wird ein Rahmenvertrag mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Bieter sind aufgefordert, ein Angebot einzureichen. 1.2 Art der Vergabe Die Auftraggeberin schreibt die benötigten Leistungen in einem offenen Verfahren im Sinne von § 15 VgV aus. Dieses Vergabeverfahren wird aus Gründen der Transparenz über eine elektronische Vergabeplattform betrieben. Bei einem Unterauftrag überträgt der Bieter die Ausführung eines wesentlichen Teils des Auftrags auf einen Dritten, ohne dass es sich dabei jedoch zwingend um einen Fall der Eignungsleihe handeln muss, z.B. wenn der Bieter selbst die Eignung für die Erbringung einer Leistung besitzt und sich trotz- dem eines Unterauftragnehmers bedient (bloße Unterauftragsvergabe). Zu den in den jeweiligen Konstellationen geforderten Angaben und Unterlagen: a) Eignungsleihe: Sofern der Bieter (bzw. die Bietergemeinschaft) im Hinblick auf die erforderliche wirtschaftliche und finanzielle sowie die technische und berufliche Leistungsfähigkeit beabsichtigt, die Kapazitäten ande- rer Unternehmen in Anspruch zu nehmen (Eignungsleihe), hat er mit dem Angebot im Verzeichnis der Drittunternehmen unter Ziffer 2 des Angebotsschreibens (Anlage V4) folgende Angaben zu machen: • Angabe der Kapazitäten, auf die sich bei der Eignungsprüfung berufen werden soll. • Namentliche Benennung der Unternehmen, auf deren Kapazitäten sich bei der Eignungsprü- fung berufen werden soll. Ein Lieferant kann einen Qualifizierungsantrag stellen und für die Qualifizierungskriterien, die Anforderungen in Bezug auf die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle oder technische Leistungsfähigkeit sowie berufliche Befähigung enthalten (3.3.2 und 3.3.3), die Kapazitäten anderer Wirtschaftseinheiten in Anspruch nehmen. Mit anderer Wirtschaftseinheit ist eine andere (natürliche oder juristische) Person als der Lieferant selbst gemeint. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Pristojna oseba za podpis je bodisi zakoniti zastopnik oziroma oseba, ki razpolaga s pooblastilom za zastopanje gospodarskega subjekta oziroma oseba, ki ima pooblastilo za podpis potrdila, oziroma potrdilo podpiše oseba, ki je v delovni organizaciji pooblaščena za vodenje sektorja, kjer je bil referenčni projekt izveden. Dokazila morajo biti v slovenskem jeziku (ali prevedena v slovenski jezik). (Ponudnik lahko pogoj izpolni s partnerjem ali podizvajalcem, če bodo slednji prevzeli dela na projektu za katere podajajo reference.) 2.2. Ponudnik mora v ponudbi nominirati tehnične strokovnjake, ki bodo sodelovali pri izvajanju predmeta javnega naročila: - vsaj en certificiran svetovalec za ponujeno rešitev: ki je zadnjih 5 letih pred objavo obvestila o naročilu kot svetovalec sodeloval pri implementaciji vsaj dveh PPM/SPM rešitev, ki kumulativno zagotavlja upravljanje strategije, projektov, portfeljev, virov in poročanje ki razpolaga z veljavnih certifikatom proizvajalca ponujene rešitve (kopija certifikata se preloži v ponudbi) - vodjo projekta: ki razpolaga z veljavnim mednarodno priznanim certifikatom s področja projektnega, programskega ali portfeljskega upravlj

veljavnega certifikata se preloži v ponudbi) ki je zadnjih 5 letih pred objavo obvestila o naročilu kot vodja projekta sodeloval pri implementaciji vsaj dveh PPM/SPM rešitev, ki kumulativno zagotavlja upravljanje strategije, projektov, portfeljev, virov in poročanje - tehničnega strokovnjaka: ki je zadnjih 5 letih pred objavo obvestila o naročilu kot tehnični strokovnjak sodeloval pri implementaciji vsaj dveh PPM/SPM rešitev, ki kumulativno zagotavlja upravljanje strategije, projektov, portfeljev, virov in poročanje Dokazilo: ustrezno izpolnjen in podpisan obrazec »ESPD« in ustrezno izpolnjen/i in podpisan/i obraz/ec/ci »Seznam kadra«, »Reference kadra« in »Referenčno potrdilo- kader« ter fotokopije certifikatov Izbrani ponudnik bo dolžan naročnika obveščati o vsaki kadrovski spremembi pri izvajanju storitev tega naročila (ob vsaki spremembi bo moral predložiti dokumente, ki izkazujejo usposobljenost kadra). Kot sprememba se štejejo morebiti dodatni priglašeni kadri, ki bi opravljali predmetne storitve, kot tudi morebitna zamenjava v ponudbi prijavljenega kadra. Če bo prijavljen kader v času izvajanja pogodbe zapustil ekipo, ga bo moral izvajalec nadomestiti z novim priglašenim kadrom, ki izpolnjuje zahtevane kadrovske pogoje. Naročnik zahteva, da bo izvajalec ves čas izvajanja proje

h praks za prej navedene vidike zasnove. Naročnik si pridržuje pravico, da od ustrezne tretje osebe zahteva poročilo o reviziji podatkovnega centra, da lahko preveri izvajanje najboljših praks. Zagotoviti je treba utemeljitev za opustitev katere koli od navedenih „pričakovanih“ najboljših praks. III. Uspešno zaključena implementacija pomeni, da je bila rešitev predana v produkcijsko uporabo in jo naročnik uporablja za podporo svojim poslovnim procesom (naveden opis velja tudi za izkazovanje kadrovske sposobnosti) Dokazilo: ustrezno izpolnjen in podpisan obrazec »ESPD« in ustrezno izpolnjen/i in podpisan/i obraz/ec/ci »Seznam referenc« in izpolnjen obrazec »Referenčno potrdilo – posel« potrjen s strani končnega naročnika (uporabnika) referenčnega posla. Referenčni posli morajo biti potrjeni s strani pristojne osebe. Pristojna oseba za podpis je bodisi zakoniti zastopnik oziroma oseba, ki razpolaga s pooblastilom za zastopanje gospodarskega subjekta oziroma oseba, ki ima pooblastilo za podpis potrdila, oziroma potrdilo podpiše oseba, ki je v delovni organizaciji pooblaščena za vodenje sektorja, kjer je bil referenčni projekt izveden. Dokazila morajo biti v slovenskem jeziku (ali prevedena v slovenski jezik). sla_onsite.text: i s programsko opremo za izdajanje dokumentov, kot so vizumi, osebne izkaznice ali potni listi, pri čemer se kot ustrezne štejejo izkušnje z uporabo, implementacijo, vzdrževanjem ali podporo tovrstni programski opremi v katerikoli državi članici EU(strokovnjak je delal za EU državo). V primeru skupne ponudbe lahko pogoj partnerji izpolnijo skupaj. V primeru, da ponudnik nastopa s podizvajalci, lahko pogoj ponudnik in podizvajalci dokazujejo skupno. DOKAZILO: - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz prve alineje prvega odstavka te točke: Izpolnjen obrazec P- 10 Referenca ponudnika. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopo

zvesti javno naročilo s podizvajalcem, ki zahteva neposredno plačilo, mora: - glavni izvajalec v pogodbi pooblastiti naročnika, da na podlagi potrjenega računa oziroma situacije s strani glavnega izvajalca neposredno plačuje podizvajalcu, - podizvajalec predložiti soglasje, na podlagi katerega naročnik namesto ponudnika poravna podizvajalčevo terjatev do ponudnika, - glavni i zvajalec svojemu računu ali situaciji priložiti račun ali situacijo podizvajalca, ki ga je predhodno potrdil. V primeru nastopanja s podizvajalci, kjer ni neposrednega plačila, mora glavni izvajalec najpozneje v 60 dneh od plačila končnega računa oziroma situacije poslati naročniku svojo pisno izjavo in pisno izjavo podizvajalca, da je podizvajalec prejel plačilo za izvedene gradnje ali storitve oziroma dobavljeno blago, neposredno povezano s predmetom javnega naročila. V nasprotnem primeru naročnik Državni revizijski komisiji poda predlog za uvedbo postopka o prekršku iz 2. točke prvega odstavka 112. člena ZJN-3. Ponudnik v razmerju do naročnika v celoti odgovarja za izvedbo prejetega naročila, ne glede na število podizvajalcev, ki jih navede v svoji ponudbi. Izbrani izvajalec bo moral med izvajanjem javnega naročila naročnika obvestiti o morebitnih spremembah glede podizvajalcev, ki jih namerava nakn

avnem varstvu v postopkih javnega naročanja (Uradni list RS, št. 43/11 s spremembami in dopolnitvami, v nadaljnjem besedilu ZPVPJN). Navodila ponudnikom Stran 18/18 Zahtevek za revizijo se vloži preko portala e-Revizija. Vlagatelj mora skladno z 71. členom ZPVPJN plačati takso v višini 4.000,00 EUR na transakcijski račun Ministrstva za finance, št. 01100-1000358802, odprt pri Banki Slovenije, Slovenska 35, 1505 Ljubljana, sklic 11 16110-7111290-00010326, namen nakazila: taksa za postopek revizije javnega naročanja. Vlagatelj mora zahtevku za revizijo priložiti potrdilo o plačilu takse. veleposlanik Andrej Gregor Rode, v. d. generalnega sekretarja Objaviti: - na portalu javnih naročil. ===== FILE: files/Razpisna dokumentacija 103_26 EU JN MZEZ_unpacked/P-10 Referenca.docx ===== REFERENCA Izjavljamo, da je bil zgoraj naveden referenčni posel izveden strokovno, kvalitetno, pravočasno, v skladu s standardi in zahtevami naročnika in v skladu z določili pogodbe. Naročnik v nobenem delu procesa obdelave osebnih podatkov ne dovoljuje izvoza podatkov v države izven Evropske unije in v mednarodne organizacije. Po zaključku pogodbenega razmerja na podlagi te pogodbe, je izvajalec morebitne osebne podatke v svoji posesti dolžan nepovratno uničiti oziroma vrniti naročniku, če ta to zahteva. emite õiguspärase kasutamise takistamiseks. Täitja vastutab ainuisikuliselt lepingu täitmiseks vajalike lubade ja litsentside saamise eest. Tellija teeb täitjaga mõistlikku koostööd, hoidmaks ära selliste lubade või litsentside väljaandmise asjatut viivitamist või väljaandmisest keeldumist. Tellija võib lepingu erakorraliselt üles öelda, kui täitja ei saa lepingu täitmiseks vajalikku luba või litsentsi. Täitja garanteerib, et tal on õigus anda tellijale lepingu objektiks oleva tarkvara ja teiste autori- või muude sarnaste õigustega kaitstavate esemete kasutamisõigus. Täitja garanteerib, et nimetatud kasutusõiguse üleandmisega ei rikuta kolmandate isikute õigusi. Kui kolmas isik esitab oma õiguste rikkumise tõttu tellija vastu hagi ning see rahuldatakse, tasub täitja võimalikud kahjuhüvitusnõuded, samuti õigusabikulud ja muud seonduvad kulud. Täitja lepingujärgsete kohustuste täitmine ei tohi tekitada häireid tellija mistahes teiste liidestatud süsteemide talitluses. Täitja garanteerib, et kõik seadmed, telekommunikatsioonid, tarkvara ja teenused on vastastikku ühilduvad, funktsioneerivad ja töötavad standardite ja/või liideste vahendusel rahuldavalt koos mistahes teiste lepingus sätestatud seadmete, telekommunikatsioonide, tarkvara ja teenustega ning lepingus sätestatud keskkonnas

e tulemustega. Koos töödega antakse üle ka tööde juurde kuuluv tehniline ja muu selle kasutamiseks ja haldamiseks vajalik dokumentatsioon. Akti esitamisele järgnevast tööpäevast arvates on tellijal 20 tööpäeva aega tööde ülevaatamiseks. Tellijal on õigus vajadusel nimetatud perioodi pikendada ühe korra maksimaalselt eelmainitud aja võrra, teavitades sellest enne tähtpäeva saabumist täitjat 3 tööpäeva ette. Enne tööde vastuvõtmist on tellijal õigus viia läbi tööde nõuetele vastavuse kindlaks tegemiseks testid. Tellija võib tööde ülevaatamisele kaasata ja selleks kasutada kolmandaid isikuid, kusjuures nii tellijal kui ka tema poolt kaasatud kolmandatel isikutel on õigus täiendava tasu maksmiseta tööde või selle vahetulemuse ülevaatamiseks kasutada kõiki selleks vajalikke tööde või selle vahetulemusega seotud intellektuaalse omandi õigusi. Kui tööd või nende osad ei läbi teste, viiakse otsekohe pärast seda, kui täitja on teinud vajalikud korrektuurid testide edukaks läbiviimiseks, läbi kordustestid samadel tingimustel. Kui tööd ei läbi kordusteste, kohustub täitja tellija nõudmisel hüvitama talle kordustestide läbiviimisega kaasnenud kulud. Tellijal on õigus kordustestimise kulud tasaarvestada täitjale väljamaksmisele kuuluva tasuga. Tellija võib vajadusel tellimuses määrata, et tööd teos

päraselt täitjalt või tema heaks tegutsevatelt füüsilistelt isikutelt (nt autoriõigusega kaitstavad teosed, mille on loonud täitjaga mitteseotud kolmandad osapooled), siis kohustub täitja tagama, et ta on omandanud kõik vajalikud õigused, et anda tellijale edasi sellises mahus intellektuaalomandiõigused, mis võimaldavad tellijal tööd sihtotstarbeliselt, ilma tähtajaliste piiranguteta ja ilma ühelegi kolmandale osapoolele tasu maksmata kasutada. Kui täitja rikub eelmises kahes punktis sätestatud kohustust tagada endal vajalike intellektuaalomandiõiguste olemasolu tellijale edasiandmiseks või kui täitja rikub lepingu täitmisel mistahes moel kolmandate isikute intellektuaalomandiõigusi ning sellega kaasneb tellijale kahju, on täitja kohustatud selle kahju täies mahus hüvitama. Kui lepingu täitmise käigus luuakse kaitstavat tööstusomandit (sealhulgas, kuid mitte ainult patent, kasulik mudel ja tööstusdisainilahendus), kuulub õigus selle registreerimisele ainuisikuliselt tellijale. turnover_financial.text: nd ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand Kabelnetz Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Cu excepția eventualelor constrângeri de natură tehnică și/sau legală, în cazul în care vor exista limitări, condiționări sau restricții impuse de ofertant în raport cu cerințele caietului de sarcini, oferta va fi declarată ca fiind neconformă. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. It will draw them in and build on the knowledge and skill acquired in each stage. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. SCOPE OF SERVICE The Contractor shall provide enterprise -grade mobile and data services to the U.S. Embassy Panama. The prices listed below shall include all labor, service, equipment, technical support, materials, insurance (see FAR 52.228 -4 and 52.228- 5), overhead, and profit. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Unlimited Smart Phones & Tablets Plan. A flat monthly rate per cellphone line that includes unlimited: local data, local minutes on-net, local minutes off-net, national long-distance minutes,

ta export of invoices in .csv or Excel format every month • Internet browsing for wireless handheld devices • Unassigned blank SIM cards for future issuance or replacement, and the ability to provision eSIM-enabled devices on demand • Wi-Fi Calling (Voice over Wi-Fi) • Unrestricted mobile hotspot (tethering) capability without additional charges, separate data allowances, or reduced speeds. • Cellular coverage with sufficient indoor signal strength to support reliable service throughout all office areas within the U.S. Embassy compound The Contractor shall ensure that services provided through its network are delivered with high availability, reliability, voice clarity, and data performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. Mobile & Data Services 19PM0726Q0012 Page 10 of 11 The Contractor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to promptly identify, mitigate, and resolve network problems affecting Government services. The COR shall be informed as soon as reasonably possible of significant outages, degradations, and service restoration status. CALLS WITHIN PANAMA The Contractor shall pro

reliable international voice connectivity on a 24 -hour basis to the United States, Latin America, Europe, and other international destinations where commercially available telecommunications services exist. International calling services shall support clear and reliable voice communications consistent with the best commercial practices for enterprise telecommunications services. INTERNATIONAL ROAMING The Contractor shall provide broad international roaming coverage for voice, SMS, and data services through commercially established roaming agreements with foreign mobile network operators. Emphasis shall be placed on roaming availability and service reliability throughout the Western Hemisphere. The Contractor shall support international roaming services compatible with 4G/LTE services, and/or 5G services (5G services where commercially available). The Contractor shall provide the COR with an updated list of current international roaming partners and supported roaming countries at least every six (6) months. The Contractor shall disclose any significant roaming restrictions, unsupported regions, or service limitations in its proposal. SMS MESSAGING The Contractor shall provide reliable SMS messaging services on a 24- hour basis, including domestic, inter

ns and changes, lost or stolen device r eporting, billing inquiries, and service troubleshooting. The Contractor shall provide dedicated account management and support personnel who are fluent in both English and Spanish. The Contractor shall provide a dedicated customer support email address for the U.S. Embassy Panama. Mobile & Data Services 19PM0726Q0012 Page 12 of 13 In addition to email support, the Contractor shall provide 24/7 customer support through WhatsApp messaging and telephone support, with response times not exceeding one (1) hour for critical service issues. A complete hardware inventory for both the METIC and the DDC is provided as an attachment, enumerating manufacturer, asset description, sub- type, quantity, and location for each item. Lifecycle posture is described in Section 2.9. The ESS environment supports approximately 2,400 virtual machines across two virtualization environments, designated TI.com and TI.mil. The TI.com environment hosts approximately 70 percent of the total VM count; TI.mil hosts the remainder. A third VDI- speciﬁc vCenter exists but is currently offline. 8 The two environments share a converged physical infrastructure rather than running on physically separated host pools. Individual hypervisor hosts within the TI.com environment routinely serve workloads from both the TI.com and TI.mil VM populations, and s

vironment routinely serve workloads from both the TI.com and TI.mil VM populations, and shared networks carry traffic from both. Workload separation between the two environments is logical rather than physical. Recent utilization metrics indicate that approximately one-third of the total VM inventory is powered off but retained. Of the active, powered-on VMs, a portion operate at near-zero CPU utilization, resulting in approximately half of the aggregate VM inventory showing minimal active operational use. Additionally, current utilization data indicates that some active VMs are conﬁgured with capacity exceeding their actual workload requirements, while storage capacity is occupied by long-retained snapshots and thin-provisioning overhead. The current VM inventory spans two governance layers. Core ESS infrastructure VMs are managed under the ESS infrastructure project's authority. Program-supported VMs, including but not limited to those associated with DHMSM, JOMIS, EIDS, and FEHRM- managed workloads, are managed under their respective program's authority and require program engagement for any disposition. The scope of this includes the physical location, furnishings, electricity, heating and cooling, management of physical equipment, and physical testing layout. • Section 2: The computer infrastructure includes network connectivity and conﬁguration, compute resources, storage, speciﬁc medical devices used for testing, laptops, mobile devices and security services. • Section 3: Testing has three sections. I. Mise en place des nouvelles missions confiées à France Travail par la loi pour le plein emploi France Travail a redoublé d’efforts depuis le début de l’année 2025 pour assurer la mise en œuvre de l’inscription à France Travail de toutes les personnes en recherche d’emploi, la mise en œuvre des outils communs au profit des acteurs du RPE, l’installation des gouvernances locales, ou encore le nouveau régime de contrôle et de sanctions à compter du 1er juin dernier. Depuis le 1er janvier 2025, l’inscription à France Travail a été généralisée à toutes les personnes en recherche d’emploi : les allocataires du Revenu de Solidarité Active (ARSA) dont seulement 40% étaient inscrits à FranceTravail et les jeunes accompagnés par les missions locales ont représenté plus de 1,2 million de personnes inscrites supplémentaires au 1 er janvier 2025, et depuis cette date, environ 40 000 nouveaux demandeurs de RSA inscrits chaque mois. turnover_financial.text: EPA) 1 avenue du Docteur Gley 75957 PARIS Cedex 20 Rapport des commissaires aux comptes sur les comptes annuels Exercice clos 31 décembre 2025 Mesdames, Messieurs, Opinion En exécution de la mission qui nous a été confiée par votre conseil d'administration, nous avons effectué l’audit des comptes annuels de France Travail relatifs à l’exercice clos le 31 décembre 2025, tels qu’ils sont joints au présent rapport. Nous certifions que les comptes annuels sont, au regard des règles et principes comptables français, réguliers et sincères et donnent une image fidèle du résultat des opérations de l’exercice écoulé ainsi que de la situation financière et du patrimoine de l’établissement à la fin de cet exercice. Fondement de l'opinion Référentiel d'audit Nous avons effectué notre audit selon les normes d'exercice professionnel applicables en France. Nous estimons que les éléments que nous avons collectés sont suffisants et appropriés pour fonder notre opinion. Les responsabilités qui nous incombent en vertu de ces normes sont indiquées dans la partie "Responsabilités des commissaires aux comptes relatives à l'audit des comptes annuels" du présent rapport. Indépendance Nous avons réalisé notre mission d’audit dans le respect des règles d’indépendance prévues par le code de com

ent dans le contexte de l'audit des comptes annuels pris dans leur ensemble et de la formation de notre opinion exprimée ci -avant. Nous n'exprimons pas d'opinion sur des éléments de ces comptes annuels pris isolément. Vérifications spécifiques Nous avons également procédé, conformément aux normes d’exercice professionnel applicables en France, aux vérifications spécifiques prévues par les textes légaux et réglementaires. Nous n'avons pas d'observation à formuler sur la sincérité et la concordance avec les comptes annuels des informations données dans le rapport de gestion du Directeur Général et dans les autres documents sur la situation financière et les comptes annuels adressés aux administrateurs. Les agents de droit privé de France Travail, bien que chargés d’une mission de service public, sont régis par le code du Travail dans les conditions particulières prévues par une Convention Collective Nationale agréée par les ministres chargés de l’emploi et du budget. Les agents n’ayant pas opté restent soumis au décret N° 2003- 1370 de décembre 2013 qui fixe les dispositions applicables aux agents de droit public. En matière fiscale, France Travail a été reconnu par la Direction de la législation fiscale, comme un établissement public administratif d’assistance. A ce titre et en vertu du Code général des impôts, France Travail se voit par conséquent exonéré de l’impôt sur les sociétés, de la contribution sur les revenus locatifs, des droits d’enregistrement, de la taxe foncière, de la taxe d’habitation et de la taxe d’enlèvement des ordures ménagères. De même, ses activités ne sont pas assujetties à la TVA. The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. References to Tenderer, Consultant or Applicant shall be interpreted accordingly. The proposed Training Services include but are not limited to those set out in section below. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim. LEO Leitrim Training Services are aimed at improving owner-manager skills to assist the survival and growth of micro- businesses. As per the Enterprise Development Plan, the provision of training is a fundamental aspect of LEO supports to entrepreneurs in the county. The Local Enterprise Office cur

As and when additional programmes arise over the life of the Panel, LEO Leitrim will either award these programmes to the initial firm identified to deliver the programme or identify the most appropriate service provider on the panel based on availability, reliability & quality of programme / trainer based on the specific needs and by reference to the original tenders. Other Requirements Which Arise LEO Leitrim recognises that training & business needs are constantly evolving and this in turn may require changes to our training offerings. Where new training requirements are identified, LEO Leitrim may run a mini-tender among the most suitable panel members based on changing needs emerging and by reference to the original tenders. LEO Leitrim reserves therefore, the right to run a mini -tender competition for additional training programmes falling within the scope of this contract at all times. Educational Services falls under CPV codes: 80000000 to 80660000 and includes ‘Education and Training Services’ (CPV code 80000000), ‘Secondary Education Services’ (CPV code 80200000), and ‘Technical and vocational secondary education services’ (CPV code 80210000). Therefore, the service is not fully subject to the provisions of Directive 2014/24/EU. Given the strategic partnership of this service, the Contracting Authority considers the creation of a Panel as the most appropriate and workable procurement process for the provision of eBooks. A Panel constitutes a means of assessing the financial and technical capacity of a number of economic operators to whom individual contracts may or may not be awarded over the Panel’s duration. The Contracting Authority is planning to run a two-stage tender process. In the initial stage, all providers who meet the Selection Criteria included in the Qualification Questionnaire Document will be admitted to the Panel. The second stage of this competition is Contracts. Contracts will be signed by the Contracting Authority with each provider, identifying the terms and conditions including the scope of the services, costs and any other operations terms required. The purpose of the procedure is to enable the pre-qualification of suitable parties over two (

Admission to a panel does not guarantee the award of any contract to any economic operator, nor does it give the member the right to be consulted in respect of, or tender for, any contract. Admission to the panel will be conditional upon acceptance of the Contracting Authority’s terms and conditions. 5.6 Fees and inclusive rates Panel members shall not be reimbursed any additional costs or expenses incurred by it, or by Key Personnel in the course of providing the Services unless these are agreed in advance and in writing by the ETBs. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. De persoonsgegevens zullen uitsluitend met het oog op de plaatsing en de uitvoering van de opdracht worden verwerkt. De toegang tot en de inzage in de documenten worden beperkt tot de medewerkers van het agentschap Facilitair Bedrijf, AgO en de instanties die bevoegd zijn voor de administratieve – en begrotingscontrole, voor wie de toegang en inzage vanuit hun functie nodig zijn in het kader van de plaatsing en de uitvoering van de opdracht. De persoonsgegevens zullen worden verwerkt (opgeslagen, …) op de IT-systemen van het agentschap Facilitair Bedrijf en AgO, die zich binnen de Europese Unie bevinden. De inschrijver heeft de toes

n aangetekende zending hoeft echter niet elektronisch te zijn. De persoonsgegevens zullen uitsluitend met het oog op de plaatsing en de uitvoering van de opdracht worden verwerkt. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. The Government of Mozambique (GOM) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds towards the payment for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) involve provision of integrated 360-degree communications services to UCP, covering strategic planning, execution, monitoring, and evaluation of all institutional, programmatic, and project communications activities, in accordance with national standards and World Bank requirements.

Co wynikało z ideologii socjalizmu państwowego: zgodnie z ideami Marksa towarzysze widzieli w piosenkarzach, reżyserach czy aktorach demiurgów społecznych. Z tego względu było jasne, że wesołe obchody Święta Pracy wiązały się nie tylko z pochodami, na których pierwszy sekretarz witał reprezentację artystów, ale również z wy- stępami piosenkarek, wyczekiwanych przez spragniony rozrywki lud. Nie przez przypadek Polskę, ironicznie i dwuznacznie, nazywano najweselszym barakiem w obozie wschod- nim. The expected duration of the project is thirty-six (36) months. 1.2 OBJECTIVE The objective of this project is to acquire quality and timeous Design, General and Specialised Printing Services as and when required, for the printed material to be delivered across the nine (9) South African Provinces – inclusive of orders from CCMA Offices located in the Provinces 1– for the service provider to protect the CCMA’s copyright, and to treat all material provided with confidentiality. 1.3 BACKGROUND The CCMA is an independent and autonomous organisation that was established by the Labour Relations Act of 1995 (LRA) to deliver dispute prevention and resolution services to the people of South Africa. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

Le Programme de Résilience du Système Alimentaire en Afrique de l’Ouest (PRSA/FSRP) approuvé par les Administrateurs de la Banque mondiale le 18 novembre 2021 est mis en œuvre dans le cadre d’une approche programmatique multi-phases. Les phases I et II comprennent le Burkina Faso, le Mali, le Niger, le Togo, le Tchad, le Ghana et la Sierra Leone ainsi que les trois organisations régionales mandatées pour assurer la coordination et renforcer les capacités durables : la Communauté économique des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (CEDEAO), le Conseil ouest et centre africain pour la recherche agricole (CORAF) et le Centre Régional AGRHYMET (CRA) du Comité permanent interétatique de lutte contre la sécheresse au Sahel (CILSS).

Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juh

esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Assessment is also in very much scope and there has been substantial work done on assessment in the past. 4.10 International landscape Ireland is part of the European Higher Education Area, the European Research Area. Irish agencies and educational institutions are networked internationally. QQI, for example, is a member of ENQA (The European Association for Quality Assurance in Higher Education) and registered with EQAR (The European Quality Assurance Register for Higher Education - EQAR). Ireland’s NFQ is referenced both to the QF-EHEA (Qualification Frameworks - EHEA) and the EQF (The European Qualifications Framework (EQF) | Europass). The EQF spans all levels of the NFQ whereas QF-EHEA only spans the higher-education levels. Both QQI and providers of education and training programmes in Ireland are subject to the Standards and guidelines for quality assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG) for higher education. EQAVET ( EQAVET - European Quality Assurance in Vocational Education and Training - Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion) is relevant to FET activity. the context of RPL is in scope. 5.21 Revision of ESG due in 2027 The second edition of the Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area (ESG), published in 2015, contains guidance on teaching, learning and assessment. QQI’s Assessment and Standards document aligns with the first edition of the ESG which was published in 2005. The 2015 version is significantly different from the 2005 version in respect of assessment. Topics related to assessment arise in many of the standards in Part 1 and not only in the standard dealing with teaching, learning and assessment. One difference is that there is a specific reference to upholding academic integrity and vigilance against academic fraud (standard 1.1). The current edition of the ESG is approaching ten years of age, is under review and is due to be replaced in 2027. A consultation draft was published in November 2025. The work ‘draws on the outcomes of the QA-FIT project’. 5.22 External quality assurance of assessment External examining and external authentication and external quality assurance by other agencies and parties have traditionally been key parts of the quality assurance infrastructure for assessment in higher education and further education respectively. Now is a good time to take stock of these

Their reason for being is to establish and maintain learning environments that facilitate learning. Formative assessment is a key part of this. Formative assessment involves assessment of learning for the purpose of supporting learning. It provides an opportunity for feedback to learners. That feedback may arise in various ways including being based on analysis of the learner’s performance. For example, with a large proportion of the Irish population entering higher education each year inclusive assessment is now more important than ever. Inclusivity is necessary for validity because if an assessment of an intended learning outcome is not inclusive then failure in the assessment by a learner is not necessarily attributable to their failure to achieve the intended learning outcomes. Inclusive assessment that is aligned to well-crafted intended learning outcomes is an important contributor to the quality of teaching, learning opportunities and assessment. The availability to learners of powerful generative artificial intelligence tools complicates matters by constraining the approaches that can be used for high-stakes summative assessment. This challenges validity more generally and not only inclusivity. While designing for inclusivity (and validity more generally) is to be promoted it may not be possible to foresee all eventualities and therefore reasonable accommodations will need to be made. Inclusive assessment may be perceived to be more resource intensive than assessment that assumes all learners can be assessed in the same way (e.g. by an invigilated, fixed time, in-person written examination). Use of AI in education and vocational training is regarded as ‘high risk’ and among the activities listed under this heading is the following ‘AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels.’ High risk systems, for example, require human oversight (Article 14) and must ‘achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle’ (Article 15). The Guidelines for the Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Public Service are also relevant. Regarding human oversight they state: All AI tools used in the public service must be part of a process that has human oversight built into it. This may include a human directly overseeing decisions in real time (“human-in-the-loop”), allowing the system to operate autonomously with the ability to be overridden or stopped by a human as needed (“human-on-the-loop”) or at a higher level (“human-in-command”). Tratamiento de datos. 1. Obligaciones generales y obligaciones del prestador de servicios como encargado del tratamiento. El adjudicatario se comp romete a cumplir, en el desarrollo de sus funciones, la normativa vigente relativa a la protección de datos personales y, en particular, el Reglamento (UE) 2016/679, de 27 de abril, relativo a la protección de las personas físicas en lo que respecta al tratamiento de datos personales y la libre circulación de esos datos en adelante RGPD), la Ley Orgánica 3/2018, de 5 de diciembre, de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales (en adelante LOPDGDD) y demás disposiciones complementarias. El adjudicatario está obligado a mantener la más absoluta confidencialidad y reserva sobre todos aquellos datos y documentos relacionados con el contrato que maneje. Esta obligación subsistirá aún después de finalizada la ejecución del contrato. En todo caso, el adjudicatario accederá únicamente a la información mínima e imprescindible para la ejecución del contrato, aunque las herramientas informáticas permitan un acceso mayor. Existirá una relación act

citada normativa, la adjudicataria queda obligada a informar a su personal del deber de guardar secreto sobre los datos de carácter personal y cualesquiera informaciones o circunstancias relativas a las personas cuyos datos pudiera conocer por razón de su trabajo. El adjudicatario seguirá, respecto de los datos, las concretas instrucciones que reciba de la unidad gestora del contrato, no aplicando o utilizando dichos datos con finalidades distintas a las especificadas y no comunicando a ningún tercero, ni siquiera para su conservación, los datos facilitados. Si el adjudicatario considera que alguna de las instrucciones infringe el RGPD, la LOPDGDD o cualquier otra disposición en materia de protección de datos de la Unión o los Estados miembros, informará inmediatamente al SNS-O. Asimismo, la adjudicataria se compromete a tomar las medidas ne cesarias para la buena conservación de la información y del material de cualquier tipo suministrado o perteneciente al Servicio Navarro de Salud - Osasunbidea, garantizar su confidencialidad, su integridad y disponibilidad y la resiliencia permanente de los sistemas de tratamiento en caso de incidencia física o técnica. Las medidas de seguridad con las que se cuente de modo constante, además de las ya citadas referidas al per

me a las instrucciones dictadas por la unidad gestora del contrato. Así mismo, entregará los datos de carácter personal y clínico, originados como consecuencia de la asistencia prestada a los pacientes, al Servicio Navarro de Salud -Osasunbidea, siguiendo las citadas instrucciones. 6. In accordance with this Contract and its annexes, the Seller designs the Trams, manufactures them and transports them at its own expense to the Republic of Estonia, delivering the Trams together with all Tram documents (including working drawings) to the Buyer in Tallinn, at the address Vana-Lõuna 41 or at another address specified by the Buyer. The Seller confirms that the ownership of the Trams, special devices, spare parts and other items to be delivered under the Contract belongs to the Seller and that no third party has any rights to them and that no third party has any basis for claiming any such rights. The Seller undertakes to coordinate with the Buyer in writing the interior and exterior design of the Trams to be delivered by submitting a 3D model of the Tram to the Buyer before commencing the design of the Trams. The Seller undertakes to ensure that the Tram's exterior and interior design solutions are based on modern vehicle solutions, meet modern product design expectations and fit into Tallinn's urban space.

For the sake of clarity, the Parties have agreed that the Buyer has the right to refuse to sign the PAC and FAC also in case of deficiencies of the Tram or in case of non-performance by the Seller of its obligations under this Contract and the PD. The Seller guarantees that the Trams to be delivered under this Contract are free from technical, structural, material-related or manufacturing defects or other deficiencies caused by the activity or inactivity of the Seller or any of its subcontractors. At the request of the Buyer, the Seller is required to provide the Buyer with a list of all Tram spare parts and their maximum delivery times within 30 (thirty) calendar days of the Buyer submitting a relevant request. Upon delivery of the special devices and spare parts, the Seller and the Buyer enter into instruments of delivery and acceptance. The risk of accidental destruction or loss of the special devices and spare parts and the ownership of the special devices and spare parts passes from the Seller to the Buyer on the day of signing the instruments of delivery and acceptance. The Seller submits to the Buyer for signing the instrument of delivery and acceptance of the special devices and spare parts within 10 (ten) working days after the delivery of the special devices and spare parts. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Kostnader ved utarbeidelse av tilbud Eventuelle kostnader leverandøren har ved utarbeidelse av tilbudet dekkes av leverandøren selv. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Side 4 av 21 Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Ved innlevering skal leverandøren ta stilling til om opplysninger i tilbudet utgjør forretningshemmeligheter, merke disse og levere en sladdet versjon der det er påkrevd. Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Behandling av personopplysninger Personopplysninger som inngår i tilbudet behandles av oppdragsgiver for å gjennomføre anskaffelsen, evaluere tilbud og følge opp kontrakt. Behandlingen skjer i tråd med personvernregelverket. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for at personopplysninger i tilbudet er lovlig innhentet og nødvendige for tilbudet. Fylkeskommunen har bl.a. ansvaret for regional utvikling, videregående utdanning, fylkesveier og offentlig transport inklusiv skoleskyss, offentlig tannhelsetjeneste, kulturminnevern og fylkesbibliotek, friluftsliv, fordeling av tippemidler og støtte til næringslivet. Renholdstjenestene utføres av om lag 130 renholdere organisert i team, med fokus på fleksible arbeidsformer, effektiv ressursutnyttelse og kvalitet i tjenesteleveransen. Renholdstjenestene utføres av om lag 130 renholdere organisert i team, med fokus på fleksible arbeidsformer, effektiv ressursutnyttelse og kvalitet i tjenesteleveransen. Fylkeskommunen har behov for en mer ensartet, digital og dokumenterbar oppfølging av renhold på tvers av bygg, rom

sensorteknologi, for eksempel dispensere, avfallshåndtering, maskiner og roboter. Leveransen skal omfatte nødvendig etablering og konfigurering av bygg- og romstruktur, brukerroller og tilgangsstyring, samt opplæring, brukerstøtte og administrativ bistand i forbindelse med innføring og bruk av løsningen. TFK ønsker en brukervennlig og visuelt orientert løsning som legger til rette for effektiv drift, god kvalitetskontroll og fremtidig utvikling av renholdstjenestene. As used in this provision- In writing, writing, or written means any worded or numbered expression that can be read, reproduced, and later communicated, and includes electronically transmitted and stored information. Nothing in these Rules is intended to give any person who is not a Party any right to enforce any provision of the Rules, or to confer any legally protected benefit on any such person. Severability. If at any time any provision of the Rules becomes illegal, invalid or unenforceable in any respect under the law of any jurisdiction, neither the legality, validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions of the Rules nor the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision under the law of any other jurisdiction shall in any way be affected or impaired thereby. Binding effect of determinations. Any certification or determination by NODES of a rate or amount under the Rules shall, in the absence of manifest error and except as otherwise set out in the Rules, be conclusive evidence of the matters to which it relates. In any proceedings arising out of or in connection with the Rules, the entries made in the accounts maintained by NODES will be prima facie evidence of the matters to which they relate. Non-waiver of rights. No failure of a party to exercise, nor any delay on its part in exercising, any of its rights (in whole or in part) under the Rules shall operate as a waiver of the party’s rights or remedies upon that or any subsequent occasion. New technologies, in the area of both consumption and production, such as solar panels, heat pumps, electric cars, batteries, etc. will bring challenges to the distribution system: namely, handling volatility in consumption and high peak loads on specific parts of this grid. Complementary to its usual methods (such as investment), Fluvius System Operator cv wants to develop flexibility and ancillary services as a methodology to keep the quality of its service high.
